task.question: Who won the 2026 United Bowl on June 13, 2026?
task.evidence: June 13: 2026 United Bowl in Washington, D.C. Louisville Kings defeated DC Defenders, 27–20

answer: FINAL: The Louisville Kings won the 2026 United Bowl on June 13, 2026, defeating the DC Defenders 27–20 at Audi Field in Washington, D.C. This was the Kings' first United Bowl title.

[2026 United Bowl] The 2026 United Bowl was the third championship of the United Football League, and it was the first to be played under the United Bowl name. The game was played on June 13, 2026, at Audi Field in Washington, D.C.. The contest determined the champion of the 2026 UFL season and was played between the Louisville Kings and the DC Defenders. The game began at 3:00 p.m. EDT and aired on ABC. The Kings won 27–20, earning their first United Bowl title. | other articles: Super Bowl LXI, Super Bowl LX
